text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin tracked just west of Nandi in the Fiji islands during the past 12 hours. The area reported very heavy rains and strong winds. We expect that a storm surge of 15-25 feet affected the north coasts as the system tracked by. In addition there was also likely widespread flooding caused by heavy rain and this coastal storm surge. Damage due to floods caused by the storm surge and heavy rain as well as high winds should be quite high. Conditions should be improving at this hour but it will likely be several days before the full extent of the damage can be assessed.

Tropical cyclone Justin will become a significant risk to shipping in Coral Sea to the east of Cairns Australia during this weekend. Top winds are currently 55 mph but they may increase to 85-90 mph during the next 48-72 hours. The system is currently about 400 miles east of Cairns and moving west. It should move westward for about 24 hours before stalling. It then begins to drift back towards the east. This track will keep it well east of the Australia coast during the weekend but it does bear watching.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
